# Caption Lite

> Caption Lite is a browser-based video caption editor for Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. Add animated captions, edit subtitle timing, and export watermark-free WebM video or separate SRT and WebVTT files.

Trim and crop clips for vertical, square, or landscape video. Add captions by hand, paste a script, or import an SRT file. Caption editing, reference color sampling, audio cleanup, and exporting work locally in the browser.

An account is optional for local editing and export. Cloud project sync requires Google sign-in. When beta automatic transcription is available, the service processes audio or video. AI text refinement processes caption text.
